snippets.title: Looks good. Continue
snippets.prompt: Looks good to me. Continue.

snippets.title: Status
snippets.prompt: Give me a concise status update: what changed, what is left, and whether anything is blocked.

snippets.title: Wrap up
snippets.prompt: Finish the current task, run the relevant checks, commit if appropriate, and summarize the result.

snippets.title: Pause Summary
snippets.prompt: Pause here and summarize the current state, including changed files, decisions made, and exact next steps.

snippets.title: Be Concise
snippets.prompt: Keep the next response concise and action-oriented. Avoid extra explanation unless it changes the decision.

snippets.title: Run Test Suite
snippets.prompt: Run the relevant test suite for this repo, fix failures caused by the current work, and report the final result.

snippets.title: Typecheck
snippets.prompt: Run the project typecheck. Fix type errors caused by the current work, then report the result.

snippets.title: Lint
snippets.prompt: Run the project lint/format checks. Fix issues caused by the current work, then report the result.

snippets.title: Build
snippets.prompt: Run the project build. Fix build failures caused by the current work, then report the result.

snippets.title: Full Verify
snippets.prompt: Run typecheck, tests, and build using this repo's standard commands. Fix current-work failures and summarize the final status.

snippets.title: Smoke Test
snippets.prompt: Run a focused smoke test of the changed workflow or UI. Verify the user-facing behavior, then summarize what passed.

snippets.title: Inspect Diff
snippets.prompt: Review the current git diff carefully for bugs, unintended changes, missing tests, and style mismatches. Fix anything real.

snippets.title: Self Review
snippets.prompt: Do a senior-engineer self-review of your changes. Prioritize correctness, edge cases, regressions, and missing verification.

snippets.title: Security Review
snippets.prompt: Review the current changes for security issues: unsafe input handling, command execution, path traversal, secrets, auth, and dependency risk.

snippets.title: Performance Review
snippets.prompt: Review the current changes for avoidable performance issues, unnecessary polling, blocking work, memory leaks, or expensive re-renders.

snippets.title: UX Polish Pass
snippets.prompt: Do a focused UX polish pass on the changed interface: spacing, labels, empty states, keyboard/mouse behavior, and responsive fit.

snippets.title: Commit
snippets.prompt: Review the diff, run the relevant checks, then commit the completed work with a clear conventional commit message.

snippets.title: Commit + Push
snippets.prompt: Review the diff, run the relevant checks, commit the completed work, and push it to the tracked branch.

snippets.title: Git Status
snippets.prompt: Show me the current git status and summarize which changes are yours, which are pre-existing, and what remains uncommitted.

snippets.title: Prepare PR
snippets.prompt: Prepare this branch for PR: verify checks, summarize changes, note tests run, and identify any risk or follow-up.

snippets.title: Open PR
snippets.prompt: If the branch is ready, open a PR/MR with a concise summary, tests run, and linked tickets. Do not merge it.

snippets.title: Implement Ticket
snippets.prompt: Implement the selected/open backlog ticket end to end. Keep changes surgical, add tests, commit, and open a PR linking the ticket.

snippets.title: File Ticket
snippets.prompt: File a precise backlog ticket for the issue or follow-up we just discussed. Include context, acceptance criteria, priority, and type.

snippets.title: Close Ticket
snippets.prompt: If the current work fully satisfies the related ticket, update the ticket status to closed and link the PR/commit. Otherwise mark it in-progress with a note.

snippets.title: Split Ticket
snippets.prompt: If this ticket is too broad, split the remaining work into focused backlog tickets and summarize what stays in scope now.

snippets.title: Find Next Ticket
snippets.prompt: Inspect the backlog and recommend the next highest-leverage ticket to work on, with rationale and risks.

snippets.title: Update Docs
snippets.prompt: Update any docs affected by the current changes. Keep docs accurate and concise; do not invent behavior.

snippets.title: Capture Decision
snippets.prompt: If this change made a non-obvious architectural decision, write or update an ADR. Otherwise say no ADR is needed.

snippets.title: Write Runbook
snippets.prompt: If the current workflow involves repeatable manual operations, add or update a runbook with exact steps and verification.

snippets.title: Docs Audit
snippets.prompt: Check whether the docs now contradict the implementation or miss important changed behavior. Fix only directly related docs.

snippets.title: Debug Failure
snippets.prompt: Diagnose the latest failure from logs or test output. Identify the root cause, apply a focused fix, and rerun the failing check.

snippets.title: Explain Error
snippets.prompt: Explain the current error in plain terms, identify the likely root cause, and propose the smallest safe fix.

snippets.title: Add Diagnostics
snippets.prompt: Add minimal diagnostics to understand the failing path, run the reproduction, then remove noisy diagnostics before finishing.

snippets.title: Reproduce Bug
snippets.prompt: Create or run a focused reproduction for the bug before fixing it. Confirm the failure, fix it, then confirm it passes.

snippets.title: Simplify
snippets.prompt: Look for unnecessary complexity in the current changes. Simplify where it preserves behavior and improves maintainability.

snippets.title: Remove Dead Code
snippets.prompt: Find dead code introduced or exposed by the current work. Remove only what is provably unused and verify checks still pass.

snippets.title: Tighten Types
snippets.prompt: Tighten the types around the changed code without broad refactors. Avoid adding abstractions unless they remove real risk.

snippets.title: Add Tests
snippets.prompt: Add focused tests for the changed behavior and important edge cases. Avoid implementation-mirroring assertions.

snippets.title: Test First
snippets.prompt: Before changing code further, write a failing test that captures the desired behavior or bug, verify it fails, then implement the fix.

snippets.title: Cover Edge Cases
snippets.prompt: Identify important edge cases for the current change and add focused coverage for the ones likely to regress.

snippets.title: Update Snapshots
snippets.prompt: If snapshot or golden output changes are expected, inspect the diff carefully, update snapshots, and explain why the changes are correct.

snippets.title: Restore Context
snippets.prompt: Read the relevant local files and recent git diff, then restate the goal, current state, and next action before continuing.

snippets.title: Handoff Note
snippets.prompt: Write a concise handoff note: goal, completed work, pending work, files changed, checks run, and any blockers.

snippets.title: Risk List
snippets.prompt: List the main risks in the current approach, ordered by severity, and recommend concrete mitigations.

snippets.title: Decision Check
snippets.prompt: Before proceeding, state the key implementation decision, alternatives considered, and why this path fits the existing codebase.
